name: github-operations
description: One operating contract for GitHub work: takes pull requests from branch to merge, writes PRs, issues and discussions from the repository's templates, repairs CI, and audits and cleans up repositories, with hooks that keep its reviewer agents read-only.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: A fine-grained personal access token (github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new) for the repositories you work in, with only the permissions you want Claude to have. The bundled GitHub MCP server sends it as a Bearer header. Stored in your system's secure credential store, not in settings.json.
